author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before had a plain capsule pin and a small plain ring far away (no finger holes, no overlap), reading as a bottle and a letter O; redrawn like the reference: a pin with round head, banded neck and bulging belly, overlapped by a large bowling ball with three finger holes.
omissions: Ball stands in front of the pin (not behind) so the pin's left belly keeps 8 from the ball; one neck band instead of two (two bands 8 apart leave an undersized hole); finger holes as solid dots.
